ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels dominate approximately 93-95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in localized scar patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation is contiguous across the central and inner lobe areas. High-contrast white pigmentation is limited to geometric clusters at the outer tips of both lobes and discrete, isolated spots scattered across the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees; clear bisection of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration map showing low-to-medium amplitude peaks along the entire trailing boundary. Notable increase in frequency and depth of serrations on the interior edges approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves characterizing the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering from the wide central base to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white rings (approx. 5-10 clusters) visible primarily on the right lobe and inner left lobe, consistent with lamprey or barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear marks; one prominent diagonal abrasion on the upper left lobe and multiple smaller horizontal rake marks on the lower sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-intensity white calcified clusters (barnacle colonies) are present on the extreme outer tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, altering the natural edge geometry.
